newsitem.title: UK: LIG sells remaining Woodwards businesses.
newsitem.headline: LIG sells remaining Woodwards businesses.

text.p: London International Group Plc (LIG) said on Monday it had sold its remaining Woodwards' Gripe Water and Teething Gel businesses for 5.6 million stg.
LIG, the world's largest condom maker, said that Seton Healthcare Group Plc purchased its Woodwards' business in the Far East and Australasia for 3.5 million.
It said a leading South African pharamcy company had agreed to buy LIG's remaining Woodward's business in Southern Africa and Canada for 2.1 million stg. It declined to name the firm.
It said the proceeds would be used to develop LIG'S core businesses in condoms and medical and specialist gloves. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
